title: FrontView REIT Provides First Quarter Investment Update
summary: FrontView REIT, Inc. (“FrontView” or the “Company”) today announced its first quarter investment activity. FIRST QUARTER 2026 INVESTMENT ACTIVITY UPDATE “FrontView acquired $34 million of properties during the first quarter, with net investment activity totaling $24 million, in line with our guidance,” said Stephen Preston, Chairman and CEO. “We are on track to deliver our fully funded $100 million net investment target in 2026, with a growing pipeline of opportunities in top MSAs centered around highly fungible, frontage-based real estate with strong tenants at attractive rents.
